name: clk
protocol_notes: All synchronous state updates on rising edge

name: rst_n
protocol_notes: Resets configuration pipeline accumulators status and sidebands

name: cfg_valid_i
protocol_notes: Accepted when cfg_ready_o=1; dynamic mode only

name: cfg_mode_i
protocol_notes: 0 I4I8;1 I8I8;2 FP8FP8;3 BF16BF16;4 I4FP8;5 I4BF16;6 I8BF16

name: cfg_ready_o
protocol_notes: High only when no accepted data/clear event is in flight

name: cfg_error_o
protocol_notes: Unsupported mode; in fixed-mode builds cfg_valid_i itself is an error

name: valid_i
protocol_notes: Accepted only when in_ready_o=1 and clear_i=0 and a clear is not required

name: in_ready_o
protocol_notes: No downstream backpressure in arithmetic pipeline; deasserts for config priority/unconfigured state

name: clear_i
protocol_notes: Must be asserted with valid_i=0; required after configuration and after a last beat; data may follow on the next cycle

name: last_i
protocol_notes: Valid only with valid_i=1; aligned to int_last_o or fp_last_o

name: lhs_packed_i
protocol_notes: Layout depends on active mode; unused bits shall be zero

name: rhs_packed_i
protocol_notes: Layout depends on active mode; unused bits shall be zero

name: busy_o
protocol_notes: Indicates accepted data/clear events are still in the eight-cycle in-flight tracker; does not mean accumulator is nonzero

name: protocol_error_o
protocol_notes: valid+clear; last without valid; data before required clear; event during config/unready

name: int_valid_o
protocol_notes: Pulses for every accepted integer data beat after four registered stages

name: int_last_o
protocol_notes: Same cycle as int_valid_o for the input beat carrying last_i

name: fp_valid_o
protocol_notes: Pulses for every accepted floating/mixed data beat after seven registered stages

name: fp_last_o
protocol_notes: Same cycle as fp_valid_o for the input beat carrying last_i

name: clear_done_o
protocol_notes: Uses the longer floating clear path; seven registered stages after accepted clear_i; informational and not a data-start barrier

name: int_acc_o
protocol_notes: Default width 48; two's-complement wrap on overflow

name: fp_acc_o
protocol_notes: BF16 pair/lane reduction then exact BF16-to-FP32 widening and FP32 recurrent add

name: fp_status_o
protocol_notes: OR of BF16 tree and FP32 recurrent-add status for latest accepted update

name: active_mode_o
protocol_notes: Stable while accepted events are in flight
